question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **"sign."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Sign" **means something that shows that somebody/something is present, exists or may happen. ((किसी के विद्यमान होने, अस्तित्व में होने या घटित हो सकने का) चिह्न)

 
 
• **Example**: *The patient was showing some **signs**__ of improvement.*
 
 
 
• It is the most appropriate word to fill in the blank as it fits the context of the sentence.
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.

Correct passage:

I was surprised __first__ at the news that my father spared me any thought, and second at my brother's compliment, __though__ it was backhanded. Dhri __never__ commented on my looks; nor did he encourage me to comment on his. Such useless __talk__, he believed, made people vain. Was this another __**sign**__ of change? 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2:** "Signature"** refers to a person's written name. (व्‍यक्ति द्वारा लिखा (और सदा एक ही प्रकार से लिखा) गया उसका नाम; हस्‍ताक्षर, दस्‍तख़त)
 
• Option 3:** "Light"** means something that is not heavy or dark. (हलका (अधिक भारी नहीं))
 
• Option 4:** "Symbolic"** means something that represents or is a symbol of something else. (किसी के प्रतीक के रूप में प्रयुक्त या गृहीत, प्रतीकी, द्योतक, प्रतीकात्‍मक)
